title_sq: AMBIENT ZYRE PER SHITJE TEK GALERIA - RRUGA E BARRIKADAVE!
description_sq:
Ky ambient ndodhet ne katin e trete te qendres tregtare Galeria.
Ka nje siperfaqe prej 31 m2 dhe nje verande me nje siperfaqe prej 63 m2.
Ambienti eshte shume i pershtatshem per tipologji te ndryshme zyrash.
Vendodhja eshte atribut mjaft i favorshem per bleresin dhe shfrytezuesin e ardhshem te ketij ambienti. 
Ne organizimin e prones, pervec zyres dhe verandes eshte edhe nje tualet.
Ambienti aksesohet nepermjet ashensorit ose shkalleve levizese.
Per me shume informacione dhe nje vizite tek kjo prone, me kontaktoni.
title_en: OFFICE ENVIRONMENT FOR SALE AT THE GALLERY - BARRICADE STREET!
description_en: This facility is located on the third floor of the Galeria shopping center. It has an area of ​​31 m2 and a veranda with an area of ​​63 m2. The environment is very suitable for different typologies of offices. The location is a very favorable attribute for the buyer and the future user of this environment. In the organization of the property, in addition to the office and the veranda, there is also a toilet. The premises are accessed through the elevator or escalators. For more information and a visit to this property, contact me.
